items.summary: Recommendation: keep the gated product private, authorize no new production work or spend this cycle, and reject both proposed CRO initiatives pending financial measurement. Amazon evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; site-level income is unavailable because the aggregate row is not assignable. AI spend is $948.8788343 from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-26 across 39 instrumented sites. The apparent 192.86x AI-cost-to-commission ratio is not a valid return or margin measure because the periods differ and revenue is incomplete. Contribution margin, infrastructure cost, labor cost, cost-to-learn, ROI, incrementality, and causal lift are not calculable. Minimum measurement: a date-aligned site/content cost ledger covering AI, attributable infrastructure, and approved labor costs, reconciled to site-level shipped commission and experiment exposure. Continue only existing measurement and failure containment; preserve unknowns rather than treating missing revenue or operational sweeps as zero.
